about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover SDV8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover SDV8 was a high-performance diesel variant offered across two generations: the L322 (2001–2012) and the L405 (2012–2021). It uses the TDV8/SDV8, a 4.4-litre V8 diesel that is a sibling to the more common TDV6 and SDV6 engines. The SDV8 was discontinued when the L460 generation launched, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV8/SDV8 engines for every Range Rover SDV8 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover SDV8 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover SDV8 spans two generations with the same engine family, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts compatibility across other Range Rover variants risks expensive issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV8/SDV8) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
